description: Color Stroop Task (Portuguese study version) - white background, rosa/azul/verde/preto inks, D/F/J/K keys counterbalanced between participants; version A (paper-sheet order, reading + naming blocks) or B (112 fixed mixed trials, naming block); 120 s per block

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: A = the 112 words of the paper Stroop sheet (all incongruent), in a reading block (respond to the word) followed by a naming block (respond to the ink), each after its own fixed 4-trial practice. B = one naming block of 112 congruent/incongruent/neutral (XXXXX) trials in one fixed order.

parameters.name: fixationTime
parameters.description: Time for the fixation cross in milliseconds (0 = no fixation cross).

parameters.name: isi
parameters.description: Inter-stimulus interval in milliseconds: blank screen after each trial (after the feedback, in the practice), before the next fixation cross.

parameters.name: blockTimeLimit
parameters.description: Time limit of each task block in milliseconds; the block ends when it runs out or when all its trials are done. There is no time limit per trial, and none in the practice. 0 = no block time limit.

parameters.name: keyfile
parameters.description: Key-color counterbalancing file (participant,D,F,J,K), relative to the test folder. Participants not in it get D=rosa F=azul J=verde K=preto.

parameters.name: keycolors
parameters.description: Optional override of the key mapping: the colors for D F J K separated by spaces, e.g. 'rosa azul verde preto'. Empty = use keyfile.
